interface_name.description: Network interface name to configure (e.g., 'eth0', 'enp0s3'). Must match an existing interface.

mac_address.description: MAC address of the interface (optional, for deterministic matching). Format: 'aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff'.

request_options.description: List of DHCP options to request from server (beyond default options like DNS, routes, etc.).

ipv6_autoconf.description: Enable IPv6 autoconfiguration (accepting Router Advertisements). Set to false to disable IPv6 SLAAC.

fallback_ipv4.description: Static IPv4 address to use as fallback (e.g., '192.168.1.100') if DHCP fails.

fallback_ipv4_gw.description: Gateway for fallback static IPv4 address (e.g., '192.168.1.1').

dns_servers.description: Static DNS servers to use (if DHCP does not supply them).

ntp_servers.description: Static NTP servers to use (if DHCP does not supply them).

use_timesyncd.description: Enable systemd-timesyncd for time synchronization (recommended unless using chrony or manual setup).

link_local.description: Enable IPv4 link-local addressing (169.254.x.x) when DHCP fails. Set false to disable.

ipv6_link_local.description: Enable IPv6 link-local addressing (fe80::/10) on the interface.

ipv4ll.description: Enable IPv4LL (IPv4 Link-Layer Address) fallback when DHCPv4 fails (RFC 3927).

routing_metric.description: Routing metric for routes learned via DHCP (lower = higher priority).

dhcp_client_id.description: Custom DHCP client identifier (e.g., 'mac' or a hex string like '01:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff').

send_hostname.description: Send the system hostname to the DHCP server. Set false to disable sending any hostname.

hostname.description: Custom hostname to send to DHCP server (overrides system hostname if set).

items.description: Fallback DNS server(s) to use if DHCP does not supply any.

fallback_dns.description: DNS servers to use as fallback when DHCP server omits DNS option.

fallback_gw.description: Gateway address to use if no gateway is provided by DHCP (e.g., for single-homed backup path).

llmnr.description: Enable LLMNR (Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution) for local hostname resolution.

mdns.description: Enable mDNS (multicast DNS) for local service discovery (e.g., .local domains).

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation (requires upstream resolver support).

dns_over_tls.description: Enable DNS-over-TLS (DoT) for encrypted DNS queries (requires DoT-capable resolver).

rapid_commit.description: Enable DHCPv4 rapid commit (RFC 4039) for faster lease acquisition (two-message exchange).

ipv6_router_preference.description: Router preference for IPv6 Router Advertisement handling: 'low', 'medium' (default), or 'high'.
